Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

SF20 outputs | areSetTo | LOW | in Automatic Mode ("running") | In Automatic Mode ("running"), SF20's outputs are LOW.
SF20 outputs | areSetTo | HIGH | in Manual Mode and any Enabling Device is OFF (not in centre-ON position) | In Manual Mode and when any Enabling Device11 is in the OFF state (not in the centre-ON position, meaning the enabling device is released or fully pressed), SF20's outputs are High.
SF20 outputs | areSetTo | LOW | Freedrive activated and ALL 3PE in OFF state | If Freedrive is activated and: ALL 3PE are in the OFF state, SF20's outputs are LOW.
SF20 outputs | areSetTo | HIGH | Freedrive activated and any 3PE in ON state | Any 3PE is in the ON state, then SF20's outputs are HIGH.
SF20 outputs | areSetTo | LOW | Freedrive not activated and ALL 3PE in ON state | If Freedrive is not activated, and: ALL 3PE are in the ON state, SF20's outputs are LOW.
SF20 outputs | areSetTo | HIGH | Freedrive not activated and any 3PE in OFF state | Any 3PE is in the OFF state, SF20's outputs are HIGH.
SF20 | isInvertedVersionOf | SF19 | | SF20 is an inverted version of the SF19 where the output state is logically reversed compared to SF19.
